seo.title: Wan 3 Prime AI Video Generator: Premium Wan Workflow
seo.description: Assess Wan 3 Prime for premium text, image and mixed-reference production with current limits, practical prompting, sibling comparisons and canonical quotes.

overview: Wan 3 Prime is the current premium sibling in the Wan 3 family. It keeps the same broad text, image and reference workflow shape while serving briefs that deliberately choose the Prime route. Alibaba/Tongyi owns Wan; MaxVideoAI distributes the launch endpoints through Fal and does not imply a direct owner agreement.

hero.title: Wan 3 Prime
hero.subtitle: Use the premium Wan route for text, opening-frame animation or mixed references, with two-to-thirty-second output from 480p through 1080p.
hero.paragraph: Choose Prime after the brief justifies a premium route, not because every Wan project requires it. The model can start from a prompt, an image with an optional ending frame, or a controlled reference set. Alibaba/Tongyi is the owner and Fal is the execution distributor used by MaxVideoAI for this launch.

features.title: Deliberate premium positioning
features.body: Prime is a separate current choice for teams that want the premium Wan route and can assess it against standard Wan 3. The page avoids claiming that it wins every brief or replaces the need for fit analysis.

features.title: Prompt and frame starts
features.body: Create from text or animate a start image, optionally guiding the landing composition with an end frame. Describe the transition and physical response instead of repeating every visible pixel.

features.title: Structured mixed references
features.body: Reference mode accepts several supported media categories under distinct limits. Assign identity, motion, sound or context roles explicitly and avoid combining file and public-page inputs where the contract forbids it.

features.title: Delivery-aware duration
features.body: Select a duration between two and thirty seconds and match narrative complexity to that length. A six-second review scenario is useful for price comparison, while longer scenes need a simpler sequence of readable beats.

decisionCards.title: Best fit: reviewed premium briefs
decisionCards.body: Use Prime when a production team has a clear reason to test the premium Wan route for a campaign shot, controlled product film or reference-led scene.

decisionCards.title: Not ideal: defaulting without comparison
decisionCards.body: For routine exploration or when the premium route is not a stated requirement, inspect standard Wan 3 before committing the project to Prime.

decisionCards.title: Prompt around evaluation criteria
decisionCards.body: State the identity anchors, key action, camera move and final beat that reviewers will inspect. This makes a Prime result easier to accept or reject consistently.

referenceWorkflows.title: Premium text brief
referenceWorkflows.body: Write a compact shot plan with a visible action, controlled camera and stable final composition.

referenceWorkflows.title: Premium image animation
referenceWorkflows.body: Use a strong opening frame and direct motion without asking the model to redesign the source.

referenceWorkflows.title: Reference hierarchy
referenceWorkflows.body: Name which source governs identity, movement, rhythm or scene context and stay within category limits.

referenceWorkflows.title: Responsible delivery
referenceWorkflows.body: Verify rights, consent, anatomy, geometry, text and watermark absence before a result enters campaign review.

tabNotes.body: A Prime test should answer a production question rather than repeat a standard draft without a criterion.
Tie camera movement to the subject action so the shot reads as one designed performance.
Fewer references with named roles reduce ambiguity during evaluation.

globalPrinciples: Lead with the deliverable and protected subject details.
Sequence complex action into visible beats that fit the selected duration.
Use references only when their role is explicit.
Review likeness consent, source rights and brand safety before publication.
engineWhy: Prime offers a first-class premium sibling rather than hiding a tier choice inside one generic Wan label.
Text, image and mixed-reference modes let one evaluation plan cover several starting materials.
The shared Wan control range makes standard-versus-Prime decisions comparable when scenarios match.

demo.title: Wan 3 Prime material study
demo.prompt: A handcrafted leather travel case rests on a stone table beside an open window. A craftsperson closes the brass clasp, the case shifts with believable weight, and the camera performs one slow semicircular move as late-afternoon light reveals the grain. Preserve stitching, clasp geometry and hand anatomy. End on a steady three-quarter composition without text or logos.
notes: Material behavior and clasp contact create concrete review points.
The restrained camera move protects the product silhouette.
